basic_info.description: Stunning Remodeled Home in Excelsior! This sun-filled 4BD/3.5BA home has been beautifully expanded and thoughtfully upgraded throughout. Featuring high ceilings, elegant hardwood floors, and a modern fireplace, the open layout is both stylish and functional. The designer kitchen boasts custom cabinetry, high-end appliances, an oversized eat-in island, and sleek LED lighting. Upstairs offers a beautiful primary suite along with additional well-appointed bedrooms. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with a redwood deck and a charming, low-maintenance backyardperfect for entertaining or simply relaxing.
